title: Clinical Medical Assistant
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Clinical Medical Assistant Certificate of Achievement Requirements
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate effective communication with patients, healthcare providers, and team members to support collaborative and patient-centered care.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to perform administrative tasks, such as scheduling, patient record documentation, and EHR management, with accuracy and attention to detail.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to adhere to infection control protocols, personal protective equipment guidelines, and safety procedures to maintain a safe healthcare environment.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to develop time management skills by prioritizing tasks in a dynamic clinical environment to ensure efficient and quality patient care.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to identify, observe, and practice professional conduct, demonstrating reliability, ethical behavior, and adaptability in a healthcare setting.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply clinical skills, including vital sign measurement, specimen collection, medication administration, and patient preparation, in a real-world healthcare setting under professional supervision.

notes: Catalog prints codes without a space (e.g., MEDSB37); these match closed-list codes (MEDS B37 etc.) and are not catalog additions.
Catalog text begins mid-sentence; the start of the program description is cut off, so any careers named there could not be read.

No specific career or job title is named; the text mentions eligibility for Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) and Certified Clinical Medical Assistant credentials and job prospects in 'a variety of healthcare environments', recorded as no careers.
Each printed outcome begins with 'Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to'; this phrase is part of each numbered outcome and was kept verbatim.
Requirement requires a 'C' or 'P' grade in each course.
